d8a5f6dbe4f3365c6ee5c5d8c9b4b001f7c26e0e.summary: Bitdefender blog post, published 2018-02-01, on Operation PZChao, a custom malware campaign that had been monitored for several months and was active in Asia. Among the most-downloaded files the authors found Gh0st RAT variants used in the Iron Tiger APT operation, and they say the new samples connect to a new attack infrastructure. The text describes a network of subdomains, each serving a task such as download, upload, RAT actions and DLL delivery, and payloads that can run binaries, collect data and run commands. The title frames the link to Iron Tiger as a possible return. The full…

d8d94230a79e6b5651ee9c536acfccb85d6e4f46.summary: A first-person blog account by a researcher who says they posed as a developer to engage a North Korean state-linked actor (Chollima, Lazarus) that offered a paid DApp patch. The author says the actor's repository was clean but its entry point fetched code from a remote server, which turned out to be obfuscated JavaScript for OtterCookie, a stealer malware. The author links it to the ContagiousInterview campaign against fintech and crypto engineers and executives. Some indicators were withheld from the video.
